records.public_claim_text: She reiterated that, in joining the Committee in 2023, the United Kingdom had made clear its desire to improve its working methods, to allow for a transparent, effective and fair system.

records.public_claim_text: She stated that the current working methods had hindered the Committee’s transparency, its efficiency and its ability to fulfil its mandate as set out in resolution 1996/31.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: She stated that the current working methods had hindered the Committee’s transparency, its efficiency and its ability to fulfil its mandate as set out in resolution 1996/31.

records.public_claim_text: He reiterated that the Committee was instrumental in accrediting organizations, which necessitated careful consideration of applications involving a comprehensive assessment of the nature and scope of their activities to ensure that their substantive and sustained contributions aligned seamlessly with the overarching objectives of the United Nations, as outlined in resolution 1996/31.

records.public_claim_text: He reiterated that granting consultative status was one of the most important means available to strengthen the participation of NGOs in the work of the United Nations and that Committee members had the responsibility and the obligation to examine applicants in an impartial and objective manner and in accordance with the mandate given in resolution 1996/31.

records.public_claim_text: He argued that some members had even resorted to attacking and discrediting other members in the name of supporting NGOs, which was a blatant practice of double standards and politization.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: He argued that some members had even resorted to attacking and discrediting other members in the name of supporting NGOs, which was a blatant practice of double standards and politization.

records.public_claim_text: He added that, at present, there were more than 6,000 NGOs in consultative status, and a large number of new NGOs had been granted status, which was clear proof that the working methods of the Committee were practical and feasible.
records.public_claim_verbatim_quote: He added that, at present, there were more than 6,000 NGOs in consultative status, and a large number of new NGOs had been granted status, which was clear proof that the working methods of the Committee were practical and feasible.

records.public_claim_text: He suggested that the Committee should steadily push forward the reform process on the basis of maintaining the existing working methods, based on the broadest consensus possible and in strict compliance with the rules of procedure of the Council, while fully considering operability and fully addressing the concerns of developing countries and NGOs from developing countries.

records.public_claim_text: Regarding the new online system, he stressed that it was vital for the work of the members of the Committee and the Branch.

records.public_claim_text: He expressed regret that, every year, the Committee was promised a new system, but the system remained under development.
